text: The Repair (L-Serine): Your brain makes D-Serine out of L-Serine (Wolosker, et al, 1999), so taking L-Serine feeds the NMDA spot, and maybe the GluD channels too, that D-serine switches on, which is what helps a session that ends with low fear and some mastery stick. The conversion isn't very efficient though, so some people take D-serine itself instead (more risk, but also more benefit).
reader: someone with trauma or in withdrawal who is anxious, wired, ruminating or raging, wanting to know what is going on in their brain and which of the protocol's tools does what

question_text.Q1: Why am I reading this sentence, and do I know it before I have to work through it? (the point first, in each sentence and each paragraph; a study after the question it answers; a term explained where it is first used, never in a sentence after it)
